problem-first-with-evidence.why: Opens with a clear problem statement backed by quantified evidence: app store review data (47/200), user interviews (6/8), competitive analysis, exit survey (n=340), and rating trend (4.4→4.1). Solution is introduced only after the problem section.

target-user-jtbd.why: Names specific primary user (evening/night note-takers, ~35% of DAU with session timestamps cited), secondary user (light sensitivity/accessibility), and states a well-formed JTBD in the standard 'when/want/so that' format.

measurable-success.why: Four metrics with baselines, numeric targets, and 90-day timeframe: dark mode adoption ≥40% MAU, App Store rating ≥4.3★, session length parity, churn -10% relative. Measurement methods specified. Guardrails also defined.

prioritized-requirements.why: Requirements are explicitly tiered P0/P1/P2 with rationale, expressed as user stories with detailed acceptance criteria for each. Coverage is comprehensive across all priority levels.

non-goals.why: Explicit non-goals stated: custom/fully-customizable color themes and font palettes are out-of-scope, called out in both the target user section and implicitly in the solution scope. Out-of-scope user also named.

edge-cases.why: Each P0 requirement has a dedicated edge cases subsection covering: image inversion, placeholder contrast, Android <10 fallback, no system preference default, user override vs system change conflicts, single-display of tooltip.

risks-rollout.why: Guardrails and some implicit risks (OLED burn-in, WCAG compliance, regression) are mentioned, but there is no explicit risks/dependencies/open questions section or a milestone/rollout plan (e.g., phased rollout, feature flags, staged release). The PRD is cut off before REQ-07 which may have contained more.
